method: Exploratory, reduced area 966x644; JPEG EXIF sRGB assumed, OpenCV BGR2Lab float. C=sqrt(a^2+b^2), signed hue angle atan2(b,a). Mask RGB 6..249 for all three reduced images, reference 0301 L* 15..85 and C*>10, and C*(0302)-C*(0301)>1. No registration. Selection conditioned on observed outcome; not causal proof. 6/13 derives from previously measured synthetic gain differences (134-128)/(141-128), not an inferred camera formula.
